name: The Himiko Game
source:
Welcome to the world's best Danganronpa fangame! Meet Himiko as she goes on a wacky and magical adventure with some of her friends and finds possibly the meaning of life, or something along those lines. There's love, funny, and a few other things that I really can't say without spoiling much.

[From [url=https://mesmileyface.itch.io/the-himiko-game]Itch.io[/url]]
